item.title: Resources
item.description: Seattle University thankfully already offers some resources for those who face challenges with food. But I feel that the resources should be advertised more. We currently have the food pantry, where students can get free groceries, but the process requires you to fill out an application, which some can feel embarrassing. There is also the case that some students may only need temporary help, and filling out a full application can feel arduous. There is the food recovery program, which makes ready to eat meals available, but those are only available at certain locations like the military/veteran link, or the commuter link. I think this program could be enhanced to provide greater access to ready-to-eat meals for the student population. One way to do this is to have the same program run out of The Cave at Campion Hall. This would allow students facing food insecurity to go to a place they are comfortable with, to get a ready-to-eat meal when they need it. Resources

item.title: about page
item.description: My name is Matthew Beavers, and I am a sophomore at Seattle University. I was inspired to create this project because I have Celiac disease and am also allergic to cow milk. This project was designed for Seattle University students.

item.title: Personal Experience
item.description: As someone with food allergies, my dining experience at Seattle University has been severely limited because of them. There is only one place on campus I can consistently eat at, which is Thrive Without Nine. But there are multiple problems with Thrive Without Nine. There have been consistent problems with it, mainly the pricing and the portion sizes.

item.title: Student Testimonials
item.description:
One of the reasons why I wanted to advocate for this topic is because many of my peers have had issues with the current dining experience at Seattle University. So, I decided to interview a few of my peers on what issues they have with the dining experience, and what they want to change.

Interview Questions:

  • How would you rate your SU dining experience 1-10?
    • K: 5
    • C: 4
    • M: 6
    • Mo: 4
    • E: 5
